title: Homeowner Bonus Days on a Reinstated Homesite Reservation Hold
content:
**Who receives reinstatement loyalty bonus days on a reinstated Homesite Reservation hold?**
Buyers whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage shows an active status. The reinstatement loyalty bonus is **3** days for a buyer whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage shows owner type original buyer and status active, **1** day for a buyer whose coverage shows owner type subsequent owner and status active, and zero for every other buyer.

**Does an original buyer whose coverage has been transferred receive the 3 days?**
No. The coverage must show status active; a coverage showing status transferred or expired gives zero.

**Does a subsequent owner with active coverage receive anything?**
Yes, 1 day.

**What if the buyer has no Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage?**
Zero.

| Owner type | Status | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| original buyer | active | 3 days |
| subsequent owner | active | 1 day |
| either | transferred or expired | zero |
| no coverage | | zero |
